nextReadySlice.title: Migration diagnostic-range scaffold
failingProof: A failing proof shows the repo still has no reserved BPMIG diagnostic range or analyzer test harness, so the breaking-changes workstream has no executable namespace or proof surface for its first migration diagnostics.
A failing proof shows later migration analyzer work would still need to invent project shape, diagnostic IDs, and deterministic test wiring ad hoc instead of starting from a reviewed scaffold.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Stop again for review before mass analyzer or codemod work if the first scaffold exposes a different diagnostic taxonomy or project layout than the current BPMIG/analyzer plan assumes.
